scope: New complete native supply, distinct from legacyE14 and unimplementedP02

source_to_load.resistance_interval_method: Rayleigh/effective-resistance polarization for every independent R in [0,Rmax]; independent signed load intervals
source_to_load.physical_topology_note: Positive M3 stud leads replace source5V header current; dedicated bars replace old source/AGND cable paths.

input_guard.manufacturer_conditions: TPS2663 RevG6.5,-40..125C,VIN-OUT1V,RILIM4.02k; reciprocalR propagation is a design model

external_ready_interface.source_driver: U25 LTC2910HGN#PBF pin12 active-low RESET open-drain
external_ready_interface.receiver_required: E28 SN74LVC14A Schmitt input, double inversion preserves permission polarity

known_direct_input_capacitance.maximum_known_direct_f_basis: INITIAL TOLERANCE ONLY; partial direct inventory, not full-temperature maximum

disconnect_startup.sequence: All-six-source presence debounce, then digital master/followers; only fourth digital SPLYGD permits analog master.
disconnect_startup.OV_recovery: Explicit EN reset/fault latch required; autonomous OV recovery can bypass dVdt.

feed_scenario.rear_mandatory_fuse: 0451006.MRL6A; exact hot operating resistance must be selected/bounded
